blocks.html: We all have learned a lot from this past year. Here are some highlights:

items: Evenness matters a lot even if it's only by a little difference.
Think before you screw a screw on.
Organization is key.
Have patience and be patient with your work.
It is so important to follow every single step.
It is so important to make sure you have a good foundation for your work.
Try not to get very frustrated because being annoyed won’t help solve challenges.
Details really matter.
Positive attitude is the way to go.
Help each other out.
You won’t know what will work well if you don’t try.
Be careful with your work.
If you work hard you will have success.
Teamwork makes the dreamwork.
You don't need the exact pieces to build something.
If you focus you will get things done faster.
Test along the way while you are building something.
Stay organized.
Stay focused.
Hard work pays off.
You sometimes have to destroy your work to build new things.
You don't always have to create the perfect replica.
Think before you speak.
Make sure to keep all of your work really neat.
If you work with your whole team you will have better ideas.

blocks.html: We hope we are able to learn even more incredible lessons in 2022! We are so excited for our qualifier in a few weeks and finals in March!
